An affiliate-only TikTok agency manages your creator affiliate program, recruiting, seeding, and management, while a full-service agency also handles content, ads, and often the shop itself. If your listing already converts and you just need more creators selling, affiliate-only is leaner. If your whole TikTok Shop presence needs building, full-service covers the gaps. Here is how to tell which you need.

What affiliate-only covers

  • Creator recruiting and vetting
  • Seeding and sample logistics
  • Commission strategy and outreach
  • Program management and reporting

It stops at the creator program. It assumes your listing, content strategy, and ads are handled.

What full-service adds

  • Ads (GMV Max, Spark Ads)
  • Content direction and sometimes production
  • Shop setup and listing optimization
  • Broader TikTok Shop strategy

More scope, higher cost, more of your program owned in one place.

Side by side

Affiliate-only Full-service
Creator program Yes Yes
Ads No Yes
Content/listing No Yes
Cost Lower Higher
Best when Listing converts, need creators Building the whole presence

Map the services to the actual work

It helps to see how these packages map to the real operating loop. One seller listed that loop as "1 to 3 hero products, a strong TikTok-exclusive offer, competitive creator commissions, consistent sample outreach, clear hooks, not rigid scripts" (@jordantwestecom on X). Affiliate-only owns the commissions, outreach, and creators. Full-service adds the offer, content, and paid media around them. Buy the slice that covers your gap.

How to choose

  • Your listing converts and you just need more creators selling: affiliate-only. Do not pay for services you already handle.
  • Your TikTok Shop presence is thin or new: full-service, so the pieces are coordinated rather than stitched across vendors.
  • You are unsure: start with the affiliate program, since creators are the engine of TikTok Shop GMV, and add scope only where you see a real gap.

The trap to avoid

Buying full-service when you only needed affiliate management, or hiring affiliate-only when your listing does not convert and no amount of creators will fix it. Match scope to your actual bottleneck. If the problem is "not enough creators selling," that is affiliate work. If it is "traffic comes but does not buy," that is listing and content.

The takeaway

Affiliate-only is the focused engine for creator-driven GMV. Full-service wraps content and ads around it. Buy the scope your bottleneck demands, not the biggest package on offer. For the broader build vs buy decision, see DIY, software, or agency.

Not sure what your shop needs? Book a call and we will scope it honestly, or find creators to gauge the affiliate opportunity.
